settings.heading: Do you sleep on the right mattress?
settings.subheading: 6 questions · 90 seconds · Discover your sleep profile
settings.q1_title: 1. During the night, you more often…
settings.q1_opt_a: A. Feel too warm or too cold even when the room is temperate
settings.q1_opt_b: B. Sleep well only in certain seasons
settings.q1_opt_c: C. Hardly ever notice the temperature
settings.q2_opt_a: A. Deep but interrupted by frequent awakenings
settings.q3_opt_a: A. Feel stiff or notice areas of tension
settings.q3_opt_b: B. Feel rested but need time to “loosen up”
settings.q3_opt_c: C. Get up without any particular physical sensations
settings.q4_opt_b: B. You move mainly in the first hours
settings.q4_opt_c: C. You remain almost always in the same position
settings.q5_title: 5. When you imagine ideal comfort, you think of a surface that is…
settings.q5_opt_a: A. Welcoming and adaptive, that follows the body
settings.q5_opt_b: B. Balanced, neither too soft nor too firm
settings.q6_title: 6. For you, the bed is mainly…
settings.q6_opt_b: B. A space for physical recovery
settings.result_a_p1: Your body picks up every detail: temperature, pressure, micro-movements. Sleep for you is a matter of listening and subtle balance.
settings.result_a_p2: What disturbs you is often not simply “too soft” or “too firm”, but whatever fails to adapt to change — seasons, body, daily rhythms.
settings.result_a_p3: What truly helps: natural, breathable materials that accompany the body without imposing.
settings.result_b_p1: Your body seeks harmony and continuity. You sleep best when nothing dominates: neither rigidity nor excess softness.
settings.result_b_p2: Comfort, for you, is something that builds over time, night after night.
settings.result_b_p3: What truly helps: well-balanced systems that support without stiffening and welcome without collapsing.
settings.result_c_p1: Your body values stability and clear support. You need to feel held, contained, guided by a defined structure.
settings.result_c_p2: Sleep, for you, is recovery, regeneration, order.
settings.result_c_p3: What truly helps: reliable supports and materials that maintain their qualities over time.
settings.result_hybrid_note: Your sleep profile is a beginning, not a box. Now you know whether your body tends to sleep in a more Sensitive, Balanced or Structured way – and which sensations matter most to your comfort. This is the starting point for designing a mattress and bed system that truly follows your way of resting.
